limitations: ON_DRAG+CLOSE was rejected by Figma reaction validation. The handle uses ON_CLICK+CLOSE as a cancellation demonstration. Direction, threshold, sheet tracking and physical drag are not represented or approved.

All seven Apply and 02 Back paths and all four purpose selections were exercised. The entire 28 level-by-purpose cross-product was not individually clicked; all eight purpose bindings were verified through the API.
02 Back requires entry through a setup frame; opening 02 directly has no relevant navigation history.
Later onboarding steps after 02 and their return ownership are outside this first unit.

No native Flutter, device, persistence, screen-reader, keyboard focus, reduced-motion or 200% text-scale completion claim. These remain separate implementation/adaptation checks and do not block this scoped Figma approval.
Figma Play screen-reader support was off in the inspected viewer; this review therefore makes no semantic accessibility claim.
Further art replacement is outside this state/flow snapshot. Recheck any changed visual material with the responsible designer.
